This directory maps Australian laboratories and service providers that offer
**environmental toxin testing** (such as PFAS, pesticides and metals) and
**aquatic animal infectious disease diagnostics** (such as molecular diagnostics,
histopathology and virology).

It was developed as part of the Fisheries Research and Development Corporation (FRDC)
project
[2023-006: Future needs of Australia's aquatic animal disease diagnostic system](https://www.frdc.com.au/project/2023-006){target="_blank"}.

## Using the directory

Go to [Find a lab](map.qmd) to search by toxin, pathogen, service, state or sector.
Click a marker on the map or a name in the results table to see each provider's
tests, services and website.

## Disclaimer

Listings are compiled from publicly available information and are provided as a guide only.
Inclusion does not imply endorsement. Please contact providers directly to confirm
current services, accreditation and availability.
